# Feel Home Stays

> Two private rooms and a whole flat with balcony for short and mid-term stays in Frankfurt am Main (Nordend/Westend), one minute's walk from Grüneburgweg U-Bahn station. Self check-in, direct booking with live availability.

## Spaces
- Cosy Room in City Center: private room in a shared flat, 1 sofa bed, shared bathroom, sleeps 2, from €100/night.
- Feel Home Room: private room in a shared flat, 1 bed, shared bathroom, sleeps 2, from €100/night. Free street parking after 10pm and at weekends.
- Flat with Balcony: entire 1-bedroom flat, 1 bath, balcony, cot on request, sleeps 4, €70/night (€2,100 per 30 nights) plus a €120 cleaning fee per stay, monthly stays of 30+ nights, open 1 January to 31 March 2027.

## Location
- Grüneburgweg U-Bahn: 1 min walk. Oeder Weg cafés and restaurants: 3 min. City centre: 10 min. Hauptbahnhof: 15 min. Messe Frankfurt: 20 min. Frankfurt Airport: 30 min.

## Booking
- [Book direct](https://feelhomestays.com/book.html): live availability, booking request, card or PayPal payment.
- Check-in after 3:00 PM with digital access; check-out before 11:00 AM.
- Invoices can be issued to companies for business stays.
